narr: Thunderstorms with heavy rain and gusty winds developed over the area. A few reports of trees down were received, and rainfall amounts of 3 to 6 inches resulted in reports of minor flooding.
ev: Yards were flooding and ditches were overflowing. The public reported 8 inches of rainfall in just a few hours.
lsr: FLOODED YARD, AND DITCHES WERE OVERFLOWED. PUBLICS RAIN GAUGE MEASURED 8 INCHES OF RAINFALL.
